edges.effect_quant: Long-term follow-up studies consistently show that postpartum thyroiditis raises the later risk of permanent hypothyroidism. In a 12-year cohort, hypothyroidism was present in 38% of women with prior postpartum thyroid dysfunction versus 4% of women without it, and the adjusted odds ratio for later hypothyroidism was 4.8 (95% CI 1.6 to 14.1).
edges.population: women with prior postpartum thyroiditis or postpartum thyroid dysfunction followed for several years after delivery
edges.mechanism: Postpartum thyroiditis reflects autoimmune thyroid injury that may not fully resolve after the initial postpartum inflammatory phase. Women with stronger antibody positivity, a hypothyroid presentation, or abnormal thyroid ultrasound findings appear especially likely to progress from transient dysfunction to lasting thyroid failure.
edges.summary: The evidence supports a harmful long-term association. Although some women recover normal thyroid function after postpartum thyroiditis, a substantial minority develop persistent or recurrent hypothyroidism over subsequent years, especially when the initial postpartum episode includes hypothyroidism and thyroid autoimmunity.
edges.caveats: Not every woman with postpartum thyroiditis becomes permanently hypothyroid, and the absolute risk varies with follow-up duration, iodine status, diagnostic thresholds, and the severity of the original postpartum episode. This edge concerns later thyroid failure after documented postpartum thyroiditis, not transient physiologic postpartum lab fluctuations.

evidence.notes: Postpartum thyroid dysfunction and the long-term risk of hypothyroidism: results from a 12-year follow-up study of women with and without postpartum thyroid dysfunction.

effect_quant.comparator: later hypothyroidism in women with prior postpartum thyroid dysfunction versus women without postpartum thyroid dysfunction

evidence.notes: Follow up of patients with postpartum thyroiditis: a population-based study.

evidence.citation: Premawardhana et al 2000 J Clin Endocrinol Metab
evidence.notes: Postpartum thyroiditis and long-term thyroid status: prognostic influence of thyroid peroxidase antibodies and ultrasound echogenicity.

effect_quant.comparator: long-term thyroid dysfunction in women with hypothyroid postpartum thyroid dysfunction plus high TPOAb and hypoechogenic ultrasound versus TPOAb-negative women

new_entities.name: Postpartum thyroiditis
new_entities.description: Autoimmune thyroid inflammation arising in the first year after pregnancy, often with transient hyperthyroid and hypothyroid phases.

new_entities.name: Long-term hypothyroidism
new_entities.description: Ongoing or recurrent hypothyroidism that persists beyond a transient episode and requires long-term monitoring or treatment.
